$comment: Hand-written facts the generator cannot infer: descriptions, ownership and external systems. Structural facts (packages, dependencies, tables, events) are always generated.

descriptions.@h-os/api: Legacy composition root (NestJS, superseded by Go backend in DEC-0009).
descriptions.@h-os/contracts: Shared Zod schemas, permission constants, event types and API types. The only cross-app import.
descriptions.@h-os/hr-api: H-HR backend module: employee records, employment episodes, organization structure and audit.
descriptions.@h-os/hr-web: H-HR frontend screens: directory, profile, organization, self-service.
descriptions.@h-os/i18n: i18next instance and the shell catalogs (English and Arabic).
descriptions.@h-os/kernel: Platform kernel: identity, sessions, authorization, audit, outbox, problem details.
descriptions.@h-os/ui: Design tokens and unstyled-safe primitives shared by every screen (DEC-0004).
descriptions.@h-os/web: Single web shell: routing, session, launcher and app host (DEC-0004).
descriptions.@h-os/web-client: Browser API client, session provider, permission helpers and formatting.
